our_title: gmap/dgmap test argv[i][1] for a missing cluster load after '-q': message is dead
ran: echo 'cmplt 3' | gmap bump.grf - /dev/null -q -> "gmap: ERROR: main: invalid cluster load ''" (dgmap -np 1 same); patched: "main: missing parameter after '-q' for gmap"
evidence: gmap.c:279-280 'if (argv[i][1] == '\\0')\n              errorPrint ("main: missing parameter after '-q' for gmap");' (argv[i][1] is 'q')

our_title: Sequential tools leak the execution context on the -h/-V early returns
ran: ASan: gmap -h (pristine and patched) -> 'Direct leak of 56 byte(s) ... _SCOTCHcontextValuesInit common_values.c:81 ... SCOTCH_contextInit library_context.c:113 ... main gmap.c:192'; gord -h too (SCOTCH_contextInit is called before option parsing, the early returns skip SCOTCH_contextExit)
evidence: gmap.c:192 'SCOTCH_contextInit (&contdat);                  /* Set default context          */' before the option loop; :261-262 'usagePrint (stdout, C_usageList);\n          return     (EXIT_SUCCESS);'

fix_options.label: a. Leave as is
fix_options.summary: process exit frees everything; only visible under LeakSanitizer (the check targets run with detect_leaks=0 for this reason)
